C0107.title: Machine Advertising Analyzes Sources of App Install Fraud
C0107.summary: In 2018, Machine Advertising found that app install fraud is a global issue, with high proportions of malicious actors in Russia, Israel, and Southeast Asia. Fraud methods include using device farms for manual click flooding and technical approaches such as SDK spoofing and install hijacking to generate fake installs, siphoning advertisers' cost-per-install budgets.
